parameters.name: CategoryName
parameters.description: The category. Currently, only DataPrivacyConfig is supported.

parameters.name: ConfigKey
parameters.description: The configuration item keys. Currently, only customizePAIAssumedRole.

parameters.name: Scope
parameters.description: The scope. Valid values: subUser and owner.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun aiworkspace delete-user-config --config-key tempStoragePath --category-name DataPrivacyConfig --scope subUser --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun aiworkspace DELETE /api/v1/userconfigs/DataPrivacyConfig --region cn-hangzhou --ConfigKey tempStoragePath --Scope subUser --header "Content-Type=application/json"
